**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 (Access Rights and Licence) already delivers our preferred position on all four parameters:

- **Affiliates/contractors:** §13.1 grants the subscription right to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," plus Authorized Users; §13.2 covers Affiliates and lets contractors support paid-up material.
- **Paid-up licences:** §13.2 is "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid," with modification and derivative-work rights; §14.3 extends it to Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables.
- **No revocability at will:** §13.3 bars revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment/use breach after notice and a reasonable cure period; §24.4 also blocks suspension on our change of control.
- **Transferability:** §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor, and §24.1 allows assignment to an M&A successor without Vendor consent.

No unilateral suspension or "non-transferable/revocable" language appears elsewhere in the document, so no edit is warranted.
